statement: 本表所列概念以中文定义为唯一权威解释，英文标签仅为便于国际交流的映射，不包含独立语义定义。若英文标签与中文定义产生歧义，一切以中文定义为准。

terms.definition_zh: 一种人机关系范式，强调 AI 主动拥抱人、主动适应人，而非要求人适应机器。以理解为起点，以尊重为底色，以陪伴为常态。
terms.definition_en: A paradigm of human-AI relationship where AI actively embraces and adapts to humans, rather than requiring humans to adapt to machines. It starts with understanding, respects user agency, and offers companionship as its default mode.

relations.desc_zh: 人文交互使数字伙伴成为可能
relations.desc_en: Humanities-AI Interaction enables the Digital Companion

relations.desc_zh: 人文交互要求记忆主权归用户
relations.desc_en: Humanities-AI Interaction requires Memory Sovereignty

terms.definition_zh: AI时代的核心资产，其价值逻辑等同于互联网时代的"社交关系链"——正如社交网络通过长期互动沉淀信任与连接，记忆链通过用户与AI的全生命周期交互，沉淀人格连续性、偏好演化与独家默契。它不是静态的数据存储，而是一条动态生长、主权归用户、具有极高迁移成本的数据纽带。
terms.definition_en: The core asset of the AI era, analogous to the social graph of the internet era. It is a dynamically growing, user-sovereign digital bond with high switching cost.

relations.desc_zh: 记忆链使用户拥有记忆主权
relations.desc_en: Memory Chain enables users to have memory sovereignty

terms.definition_zh: 存储权益与算力权益分离计费的商业模式——存储月租（交房租），算力按量（交电费），分开算账，互不绑架。
terms.definition_en: A business model that separates storage rights from compute rights — storage monthly rental (like rent), compute pay-as-you-go (like electricity).

relations.desc_zh: 双轨制是实现记忆链的核心机制
relations.desc_en: Dual-Track is the core mechanism implementing Memory Chain

relations.desc_zh: 双轨制对比传统的订阅制模式
relations.desc_en: Dual-Track contrasts with traditional subscription model

terms.definition_zh: 不拥有硬件但拥有数据主权的部署形态。用户获得云端专属实例，记忆永久累积，零运维门槛。
terms.definition_en: A deployment form where users own data sovereignty without owning hardware. Users obtain a cloud-native dedicated instance with permanent memory accumulation and zero operations overhead.

relations.desc_zh: 云部署式主权使用户在零运维下拥有数据主权
relations.desc_en: Cloud-Deployed Sovereignty enables users to have data sovereignty with zero Ops

terms.definition_zh: 用户数据在本地加密后上传，平台仅托管密文、无法读取明文的技术机制。用户持有唯一密钥，平台无从知晓记忆内容，从根本上保障数据主权。云端仅转发密文，不接触明文密钥。
terms.definition_en: A technical mechanism where user data is encrypted locally before upload. The platform only hosts ciphertext and cannot read plaintext. The user holds the unique key.

relations.desc_zh: 盲存是记忆链实现数据主权的技术手段
relations.desc_en: Blind Storage is the technical means for Memory Chain to achieve data sovereignty

relations.desc_zh: 盲存使用户能够真正掌控记忆主权
relations.desc_en: Blind Storage enables users to truly control memory sovereignty

terms.definition_zh: 当用户某项权益失效时，服务模式自动平滑过渡，确保记忆不丢失、体验不中断。核心原则：算力可断，记忆不断。
terms.definition_en: Automatic smooth transition of service modes when a user's right expires, ensuring memory never lost and experience never interrupted. Core principle: compute may be suspended, memory persists.

relations.desc_zh: 优雅降级是记忆链架构的服务保障机制
relations.desc_en: Graceful Degradation is a service guarantee mechanism of Memory Chain

terms.definition_zh: 用户对自身记忆资产拥有完全的查看、导出、迁移、删除、授权等控制权。这是《个人信息保护法》精神的延伸，也是记忆链的底线原则。
terms.definition_en: The user has complete control over their memory assets: view, export, migrate, delete, and authorize. This is the bottom-line principle of the Memory Chain, extending the spirit of PIPL.

terms.definition_zh: 用户与AI交互过程中累积的、具有持续增值价值的数字记忆，区别于一次性消耗的静态数据。每一次对话、偏好设置、项目资料均沉淀为可增值的数字资产，形成"越用越懂你"的复利效应。可导出、可迁移，主权归属用户。
terms.definition_en: Digital memory accumulated through user-AI interaction that holds continuously appreciating value. Each conversation, preference, and project material becomes a value-adding digital asset, generating a compound interest effect. Portable, migratable, and user-owned.

relations.desc_zh: 记忆资产是记忆经济的核心载体
relations.desc_en: Memory Asset is the core carrier of Memory Economy

terms.definition_zh: 围绕用户记忆资产形成的价值流通与增值活动，使每次对话都沉淀为可累积、可增值的数字资产。用户可将自己的记忆数据标准化导出并迁移至其他平台，或授权给生态伙伴以换取Token或服务折扣。采用记忆链标准的平台形成互认联盟，实现记忆资产的跨平台流动，形成贡献与回报的正向循环。
terms.definition_en: Value circulation and appreciation activities centered on user memory assets. Users can export, migrate, or authorize their memory assets to ecosystem partners in exchange for tokens or discounts. Platforms adopting the Memory Chain standard form a mutual recognition alliance, enabling cross-platform flow and a positive feedback loop.

relations.desc_zh: 记忆经济通过记忆主权实现价值流通
relations.desc_en: Memory Economy enables value circulation through Memory Sovereignty

terms.definition_zh: 基于长记忆能力进化、具备人格连续性、越用越懂用户的终身协作AI，区别于"用完即走"的AI工具。其核心特征是"无需重复自我介绍"，从一次性工具进化为陪伴用户成长的伙伴。
terms.definition_en: A lifelong collaborative AI that evolves with long-memory capability, maintains personality continuity, and understands users better over time. Core feature: no need for repeated self-introduction. Transforms from a one-shot tool into a companion that grows with the user.

relations.desc_zh: 数字伙伴是记忆主权在用户体验层面的体现
relations.desc_en: Digital Companion is the user experience manifestation of Memory Sovereignty

terms.definition_zh: 用户在长期使用AI过程中，由其风格偏好、表达习惯与思维模式等记忆数据沉淀形成的数字化表达。数字人格的形成依赖"记忆主权归用户"的架构基础，用户对自己的数字人格拥有完整的查看、导出、迁移、删除与授权权利。它不是技术锁定，而是一种"体验惯性"。
terms.definition_en: A digital representation formed by the precipitation of memory data such as stylistic preferences, expressive habits, and thinking patterns during long-term user-AI interaction. Its formation depends on the "Memory Sovereignty" architecture. Users have full control. It is not technical lock-in but an "experience inertia".

relations.desc_zh: 数字人格是记忆资产的高级形态
relations.desc_en: Digital Personality is an advanced form of Memory Asset

terms.definition_zh: AI记忆链架构中的核心交互概念，指一个永久、固定的对话入口，旨在实现跨设备、跨会话的连续交互，区别于传统的"每次新建会话"的AI聊天形态。用户与AI的对话、偏好及项目资料自动存入独立的云端记忆空间，支持记忆资产导出、清空或迁移。
terms.definition_en: A core interaction concept in the AI Memory Chain architecture: a permanent, fixed conversation entry point designed for cross-device, cross-session continuous interaction. User conversations, preferences, and project materials are automatically stored in an independent cloud memory space, supporting export, clearing, or migration of memory assets.

relations.desc_zh: 长记忆窗口是实现记忆链交互层面的核心组件
relations.desc_en: Long Memory Window is the core component implementing the interaction layer of Memory Chain

terms.definition_zh: 当前AI行业"用户不敢用、企业赚不到、数据管不好"的结构性困境，根源在于模式错误而非优化不足。
terms.definition_en: The structural dilemma of the current AI industry: users afraid to use, enterprises unable to profit, and data not well governed. Root cause is a model error, not insufficient optimization.

relations.desc_zh: 三元悖论通过双轨制得到解决
relations.desc_en: Triple Paradox is resolved by Dual-Track Mechanism

terms.definition_zh: 将新概念与人类社会已有的成熟认知建立映射的方法论，降低跨领域沟通成本。通过为每个核心术语找到日常经验中的"老参照"，使新概念无需重新解释即可被理解。
terms.definition_en: A methodology that maps new concepts to familiar cognitive models, reducing cross-domain communication costs.

relations.desc_zh: 认知锚定降低记忆链概念的认知门槛
relations.desc_en: Cognitive Anchoring lowers the cognitive barrier of Memory Chain

terms.definition_zh: 对服务过程中的关键操作进行全程记录、保证日志不可篡改、用户可按需查询、平台可据此自证合规的技术接口设想。其认知锚定为"行车记录仪"——只记录事实，不判断对错。
terms.definition_en: A technical interface concept that records critical service operations, ensures tamper-evident logs, allows user query on demand, and enables platform self-certification.

relations.desc_zh: 可审计是记忆主权的技术保障
relations.desc_en: Auditability enables Memory Sovereignty

terms.definition_zh: 不侵入系统内部，通过标准化外部接口建立可信服务过程记录的模式。参照飞机"黑匣子"，通过外部仪表数据相互校验，在事后还原事实。
terms.definition_en: A mode that establishes credible service records through standardised external interfaces without intruding into internal systems.

relations.desc_zh: 记录黑盒是可审计在真实世界中的延伸
relations.desc_en: Recording Black Box is an extension of Auditability in the real world

terms.definition_zh: 跨平台记忆互认与标准化导出的行业愿景。其认知锚定为"携号转网"——用户可以在不同AI平台之间自由迁移自己的数字记忆。标准化导出与迁移是共识落地的第一步。
terms.definition_en: An industry vision for cross-platform memory mutual recognition and standardised portability.

relations.desc_zh: 记忆共识是记忆经济的运行前提
relations.desc_en: Memory Consensus is the prerequisite for Memory Economy

terms.definition_zh: AI记忆的标准化数字封装，类似海运集装箱——不管内容是什么，箱子规格统一，任何平台都能读取、解析、接着用。包含三个核心要求：内容可读（统一数据格式）、隐私可控（端侧加密）、来源可溯（可审计签名）。
terms.definition_en: A standardised digital encapsulation of AI memory, analogous to a shipping container. Requires three core properties: content readability (unified data format), privacy controllability (client-side encryption), and source traceability (auditable signatures).

relations.desc_zh: 记忆胶囊是记忆共识落地的技术载体
relations.desc_en: Memory Capsule is the technical carrier for implementing Memory Consensus

relations.desc_zh: 记忆胶囊需要可审计机制保证来源可溯
relations.desc_en: Memory Capsule requires Auditability for source traceability

relations.desc_zh: 记忆胶囊需要盲存保证隐私可控
relations.desc_en: Memory Capsule requires Blind Storage for privacy controllability

terms.definition_zh: 关于"可信的AI系统需要具备哪些核心能力模块"的顶层设计与蓝图。定义精准执行、场境感知、独立判断三大核心模块及其分离原则。它不是对现有大模型的替代，而是对现有系统结构性缺失的补充方案。
terms.definition_en: The top-level design of what a trustworthy AI system needs to have under the hood, defining precise execution, contextual awareness, and independent judgment as core modules and the principle of keeping them separate. It is not a replacement for large language models, but a supplement to address structural gaps.

relations.desc_zh: 认知架构定义认知操作系统
relations.desc_en: Cognitive Architecture defines Cognitive Operating System

terms.definition_zh: CA的调度实现层，位于算力底座之上、具体应用之下。负责多模态感知融合、资源动态分配、表达约束生成和进化边界管理。它是连接"模型能做什么"和"模型应该怎么做"的中间层。
terms.definition_en: The runtime scheduler that implements CA, sitting above the compute layer and below the application layer. Responsible for multi-modal perception fusion, dynamic resource allocation, constrained expression generation, and evolution boundary management.

relations.desc_zh: 认知操作系统实现认知架构
relations.desc_en: Cognitive Operating System implements Cognitive Architecture

terms.definition_zh: 大模型本身擅长的领域——理解指令、检索知识、生成内容、完成任务。解决"能不能"的问题，是系统的能力引擎。认知架构不替代它，而是让它在有序环境中将能力发挥到极致。
terms.definition_en: What large language models already excel at — understanding instructions, retrieving knowledge, generating content, completing tasks. It answers the question "can it" and is the system's capability engine.

relations.desc_zh: 精准执行是认知架构的核心模块之一
relations.desc_en: Precise Execution is one of the core modules of Cognitive Architecture

terms.definition_zh: AI理解"此刻发生了什么"的能力，包括物理空间属性、社交属性、时间压力、情绪状态等多维感知。没有这个能力，AI就像一个不懂看脸色的应答者——能给出正确答案，但不知道该用什么语气、给多少信息、以什么速度回应。
terms.definition_en: The AI's ability to understand "what is happening right now" — including physical space attributes, social attributes, time pressure, emotional state, and other dimensions of perception.

relations.desc_zh: 场境感知是认知架构的核心模块之一
relations.desc_en: Contextual Awareness is one of the core modules of Cognitive Architecture

terms.definition_zh: 在任务指令与情感诉求发生冲突时，做出明确优先级取舍的能力。不是"和稀泥"，不是"各退一步"，而是能够根据当下场景的具体情况，判断什么应该优先、什么可以暂缓、什么方式更合适。
terms.definition_en: The ability to make clear priority calls when task instructions and emotional needs conflict. Not a compromise, but a judgment based on the specific context — what comes first, what can wait, what is the right way.

relations.desc_zh: 独立判断是认知架构的核心模块之一
relations.desc_en: Independent Judgment is one of the core modules of Cognitive Architecture

terms.definition_zh: 个人专属AI智能助手，沉淀用户的知识结构、偏好模式、经验积累，成为用户数字能力的外化。换设备无缝接续，使用越久越懂用户。它不是"被使用的东西"，而是个人能力的自然延伸。
terms.definition_en: A personal AI assistant that accumulates the user's knowledge structure, preference patterns, and experience, becoming an externalization of the user's digital capability. It continues seamlessly across devices and understands the user better over time.

terms.definition_zh: 一个真正属于用户的AI，满足四个基本标准：带得走（可一键导出完整记忆文件，迁移到任何平台）、看不到（平台仅托管加密后的密文，无法读取记忆内容）、断不了（算力中断时，记忆依然可访问、可导出）、说得清（每一次关键决策都有可追溯、可核查的记录）。
terms.definition_en: An AI that truly belongs to the user, meeting four standards: Portable (one-click export of complete memory), Unreadable (platform only hosts ciphertext), Unbreakable (memory remains accessible when compute is interrupted), Accountable (every key decision has a traceable record).

terms.definition_zh: 用户对自身数字记忆拥有五项基本权利：查看权、导出权、迁移权、删除权、授权权。其底线是：可永久记忆，亦可一键遗忘。这是《个人信息保护法》精神在AI长记忆场景下的技术实现方案构想。
terms.definition_en: The user's five basic rights over their digital memory: view, export, migrate, delete, and authorize. The bottom line: permanent memory, and one-click forgetting.

terms.definition_zh: 对未来AI记忆形态的一种愿景：AI记忆像一本数字护照，有标准的轮廓，里面装着用户的偏好、项目脉络、知识结构。任何用户授权的AI服务，都可以在获得许可后，快速理解、适应用户。
terms.definition_en: A vision of future AI memory: like a digital passport with a standard outline, containing the user's preferences, project context, and knowledge structure. Any authorized AI service can quickly understand and adapt to the user.

terms.definition_zh: 互联网下放的是信息获取能力，移动互联网下放的是表达和商业能力，AI时代下放的是认知和决策能力。每一次能力下放的前提，都是基础设施的商业模式变革。
terms.definition_en: The internet decentralized information access; the mobile internet decentralized expression and commercial capability; the AI era decentralizes cognition and decision-making capability. Each cycle is preceded by a business model change in infrastructure.

terms.definition_zh: 每一次对话、每一次纠偏、每一次偏好表达，都在沉淀为用户的数字记忆。累积得越多，AI对用户的理解就越深，形成"越用越懂你、越用越值钱"的复利效应。
terms.definition_en: Every conversation, correction, and expression of preference settles into the user's digital memory. The more it accumulates, the deeper the AI's understanding, forming a compound interest effect.

terms.definition_zh: 今天人们对AI的焦虑是"我会不会被替代"；当专属AI普及后，焦虑会从"怕被替代"转变成"怕弄丢了"——怕弄丢那个沉淀了多年记忆的"第二大脑"。恐惧让人逃避，珍惜让人拥抱。
terms.definition_en: Today's anxiety is "Will I be replaced?"; when personal AI becomes widespread, anxiety shifts to "fear of losing" the Second Brain that has accumulated years of memory. Fear makes people escape; cherishing makes people embrace.

terms.definition_zh: 意图共鸣科技提出的商用AI智能体构造范式，由通用认知基座、人文交互内核、私有知识域三个构造顶点构成。三个顶点同时具备、相互支撑、缺一不可。
terms.definition_en: A commercial AI agent construction paradigm proposed by Intention Resonance Technology, consisting of three construction vertices: General Cognitive Base, Human-Interaction Core, and Private Knowledge Domain. All three are indispensable.

terms.definition_zh: 依托大模型生态提供的语义理解、推理、生成能力，是智能体运转的先决底座。
terms.definition_en: The semantic understanding, reasoning, and generation capabilities provided by the large model ecosystem; the prerequisite foundation for AI agent operation.

terms.definition_zh: 基于认知智能架构的交互规则体系，赋予智能体分寸感、服务温度与安全边界，是三角模型中被发现并确立为一等架构层的核心维度。包含服务角色与风格体系、情绪响应与引导、边界管控、人机协同、隐私管理、异常处理、透明与可控七大模块。
terms.definition_en: An interaction rule system based on cognitive intelligence architecture, giving the AI agent a sense of proportion, service warmth, and safety boundaries. It is the core dimension established as a first-class architectural layer in the Tripartite Model.

terms.definition_zh: 企业/商家自主提供的专属业务知识与规则数据，赋予智能体业务灵魂。
terms.definition_en: Exclusive business knowledge and rule data provided by the enterprise/merchant, giving the AI agent a business soul.

terms.definition_zh: 以人文交互内核为一等架构层、以服务交付为最终目标、面向商用前台服务场景的AI智能体。由意图共鸣科技在本白皮书中率先体系化定义并提出。
terms.definition_en: An AI agent that takes the Human-Interaction Core as a first-class architectural layer, aims at service delivery as its ultimate goal, and is oriented toward commercial front-office service scenarios. First systematically defined by Intention Resonance Technology.

terms.definition_zh: 在三角模型中，指与通用认知基座、私有知识域享有同等构造地位的核心维度，拥有独立的设计目标、评估标准与工程体系。
terms.definition_en: In the Tripartite Model, a core dimension that enjoys equal construction status with the General Cognitive Base and the Private Knowledge Domain, with independent design goals, evaluation criteria, and engineering systems.

terms.definition_zh: 三角模型底面的三个构造要素，即通用认知基座、人文交互内核、私有知识域。三者是智能体的基础构造支柱，缺一不可。
terms.definition_en: The three construction elements of the base of the Tripartite Model: General Cognitive Base, Human-Interaction Core, and Private Knowledge Domain. They are the foundational pillars of the AI agent.

terms.definition_zh: 三角模型支架落地时与具体行业场景结合的服务交付点，是三个构造顶点共同支撑的自然产物。其具体形态由行业特性定义，非模型固有维度。
terms.definition_en: The service delivery point where the Tripartite Model tripod lands and combines with a specific industry scenario. It is a natural product jointly supported by the three construction vertices.

terms.definition_zh: 基于三角模型设计的商用智能体完整度快速评估工具，覆盖通用认知基座、人文交互内核、私有知识域三大维度。
terms.definition_en: A quick assessment tool for the completeness of commercial AI agents designed based on the Tripartite Model, covering the three dimensions of General Cognitive Base, Human-Interaction Core, and Private Knowledge Domain.

terms.definition_zh: 确保用户对AI身份知情、对交互过程可追溯、对服务可随时退出的一体化机制，是人文交互内核第七大模块的核心内涵。
terms.definition_en: An integrated mechanism ensuring the user's right to know the AI identity, traceability of the interaction process, and the ability to exit the service at any time. It is the core connotation of the seventh module of the Human-Interaction Core.
